visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Running Counter Instead of a Formula
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Each number is computed from the row and column with a formula inside two while loops. Use for loops and a counter that simply increases. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Counting upwards is simpler than deriving each number from its position, and for loops keep the initialisation, test and update of the counters in one place.
